status: frozen prospective analysis within an already explored benchmark
framing: GENCO is evaluated as a learned proposal engine for expensive four-wire envelope optimisation; exact OpenDSS remains the final decision authority
computation_note: All shrink points were computed in one cached evaluation, but the frozen q95 primary result was reported and committed before the secondary frontier was examined.

notes: features and L_ac are shared by every shrink point and arm that uses them
physical calls were shared across arms and shrink points; no superiority claim rests on caching
exact-call savings are not automatically wall-clock savings; GENCO proposal construction (~3 s, A100) and the classical proposal (~3 s, one CPU core) cost about the same
